description: This source file defines the ActivationCountPlacementDirector class, which is responsible for placement decisions in Orleans based on activation counts and silo statistics. It implements load balancing among silos by monitoring their activation counts and choosing appropriate silos for new activations.

classes.name: ActivationCountPlacementDirector
classes.description: A placement director that distributes activations across silos based on activation counts, aiming for balanced load.

classes.name: CachedLocalStat
classes.description: A helper class to cache and update activation count and silo statistics for local silos.

methods.name: ActivationCountPlacementDirector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the placement director with silo details, load publisher, and options.

methods.name: SelectSiloPowerOfK
methods.description: Selects a suitable silo considering load and compatibility, using a probabilistic approach.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Handles the event of adding a new activation, returning which silo to place it on.

methods.name: OnAddActivationInternal
methods.description: Internal logic to decide on the appropriate silo for the new activation based on cache and hints.

methods.name: SiloStatisticsChangeNotification
methods.description: Updates the cache when silo statistics change.

methods.name: RemoveSilo
methods.description: Removes a silo from the cache when it is no longer available.
